verdict.rationale: Vanta ships AI features (Vanta AI Agent, AI evidence review, questionnaire automation), so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains no statement about whether customer data is used to train models, and no opt-out control or contractual guarantee. The GDPR and privacy-workflow material concerns helping customers' own compliance, not Vanta's AI data-use posture.
